description: This PHP class 'LeaveListController' is part of the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management System. It manages the leave list functionality, including preparing UI components with leave types, statuses, employee details, and subunit data for rendering leave-related views. It utilizes traits for services like leave requests, employee info, and localization, and controls access based on user roles.

classes.name: LeaveListController
classes.description: A controller class that manages the display and data preparation for the leave list view in the OrangeHRM system, including setting leave statuses, employee info, leave types, and subunit data.

methods.name: getCompanyStructureService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of CompanyStructureService used for retrieving organizational subunit data.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component with necessary props such as employee details, leave types, statuses, subunit data, and date filters before rendering.

methods.name: addLeaveStatusesProp
methods.description: Adds a leave statuses property to the UI component, translating each status label for localization.

methods.name: addLeaveTypeProp
methods.description: Adds a leave type property to the component if a leave type ID is provided in the request.

methods.name: addLeaveStatusProp
methods.description: Adds a leave status property to the component if a status value is provided in the request.

methods.name: addFromToDateProps
methods.description: Adds from and to date properties to the component if both are present in the request.
